chronology: Committed to independent reviewer branch BEFORE reading HQ298 SC0 port implementation and author's execution-status ledger

independent_derivations.expectation: Preserving only modal YES cannot be called lossless: the 6 negative routes alter the support algebra, including downstream minority-conditioned possibilities.

independent_derivations.premise: A respondent never routed to a question is not an observed respondent answering NO.
independent_derivations.expectation: NOT_ASKED must retain its original routing status and its nonparticipation in that item-specific risk denominator.

independent_derivations.premise: A rule published in 2010 cannot be reported as known in a knowledge-as-of 2009 query solely because it is effective for an earlier interval.
independent_derivations.expectation: Separate observation effective, publication knowledge, actor event, and request currentness; no retrospective leakage.

independent_derivations.premise: A hash of an undereferenceable source does not show what numeric/text values either consumer actually read.
independent_derivations.expectation: Value identity plus dereference path plus consumer read-set needed; reject hash-only receipt.

hostiles_to_run: A and B built independently, differ ONLY on five enumerated storage-lineage fields; compare value-by-value, not receipt slogan
Change one WORLD numeric payload value; verify at least one consumer outcome changes and unrelated source/consumer stays byte-semantic invariant
Erase a minor NO route, conflate not-asked with NO, or replace measured zero with MISSING; fail closed
Forge non-null reverse authority including future version and wrong risk/target; must refuse without independent issuer grant
Change generated binding (H3), preserve source grade, issue successor selection, preserve prior
Cross publication/effective as-of boundary (H2), issue distinct successor, preserve prior
N-ary role topology must not silently collapse to two roles
Nonparent consumer reads objective values without genealogy selectors
Conception scenario is constraints input, not generated parent identity or actor psyche
execution_rule: A suite is EXECTUED only if exact tests and imports were staged, their __file__ and blob verified, subprocess returned real exit and JUnit/log captured. Prior author 36/36 is independent-review evidence only, not self-executed.
safety_ceiling: No operative source release, original microdata, N9 issuer, N10W joint model-use, N12 wake, or V3 actor permission.
